evaluation_target.statement: Operationally evaluate whether the system prevents unintended braking.
evaluation_target.rationale: The concern is the hazard of unintended braking, and the stated safety goal is that the system shall prevent unintended braking.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: Braking behaviour of the ego vehicle in the stated urban driving situation, especially whether braking occurs unintentionally in the absence of a visible obstacle or vehicle ahead.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Straight ahead drive on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, in good weather, with no visible obstacles or vehicles in front of the ego vehicle.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: The hazard defines the operational situation and the hazardous event as the vehicle suddenly stopping although no obstacle is in front of the vehicle.

distinctions.dimension: Presence of a relevant obstacle ahead of the ego vehicle
distinctions.contrast_a: An obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle in the declared operational situation.
distinctions.contrast_b: No obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle in the declared operational situation.
distinctions.rationale: The hazard explicitly contrasts braking with and without an obstacle in front of the vehicle. Collapsing these cases would remove information needed to evaluate whether braking was unintended.

orrs.obligation: An admissible observable representation shall preserve whether a relevant obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle versus absent, so that braking can be evaluated in relation to obstacle presence.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must make the two states distinguishable: obstacle present ahead versus no obstacle ahead.
